"""
LRU Cache with TTL Expiry, Thread-Safe Wrapper, and Pytest Test Suite.

This module provides:
1. A basic LRU cache implementation with TTL (Time-To-Live) support.
2. A thread-safe wrapper around the LRU cache.
3. A comprehensive pytest test suite.

The LRU cache evicts the least recently used items when capacity is reached.
TTL allows each cached item to expire after a specified number of seconds.
"""

import time
import threading
import collections
from typing import Any, Optional, Callable, Hashable
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from collections import OrderedDict
import weakref
import sys


@dataclass
class CacheEntry:
    """
    Represents a single entry in the cache.
    
    Attributes:
        key: The cache key.
        value: The cached value.
        created_at: Timestamp when the entry was created.
        expires_at: Timestamp when the entry expires (None if no TTL).
        last_accessed: Timestamp of last access.
    """
    key: Hashable
    value: Any
    created_at: float = field(default_factory=time.time)
    expires_at: Optional[float] = None
    last_accessed: float = field(default_factory=time.time)
    
    def is_expired(self, now: Optional[float] = None) -> bool:
        """
        Check if this entry has expired.
        
        Args:
            now: Current timestamp. If None, uses time.time().
            
        Returns:
            True if the entry has expired, False otherwise.
        """
        if self.expires_at is None:
            return False
        if now is None:
            now = time.time()
        return now >= self.expires_at


class LRUCache:
    """
    A thread-unsafe LRU cache with TTL (Time-To-Live) support.
    
    This cache uses an OrderedDict to maintain insertion/access order.
    When the cache is full, the least recently used item is evicted.
    Items can optionally expire after a specified TTL.

        capacity: Maximum number of items the cache can hold.
        default_ttl: Default time-to-live in seconds for new entries.
        _store: OrderedDict mapping keys to CacheEntry objects.
